evidence: The ask demands a substantial full-stack build from an empty workspace. environment/Dockerfile creates /app containing only .gitkeep (no starter app to tweak), so no trivial edit can earn anything. instruction.md:1-17 plus hireops_rules.md require: session auth for 4 roles with 401/403/404 semantics (rules s1), job/candidate creation with email validation and case-insensitive dedupe (s2), a six-stage board with one-stage moves, reject/reopen, per-stage manual order, Interview capacity, role-scoped permissions, per-card versions with 409 stale refusal naming the actor, optimistic display with put-back and focus retention, atomic multi-card moves, single-level undo with conflict refusal (s3), an append-only activity log (s4), 15-second live updates preserving focus/drafts/scroll (s5), paginated conversations with scroll anchoring, per-person unread, seen marks and per-user browser drafts surviving sign-out (s6), candidate privacy filtering (s7), and SQLite persistence seeded once and surviving restart (instruction.md:13-15). The golden needs ~1.4k lines of app code (src/index.js 450, board.js 373, threads.js 223, app.js 213, ...). Smallest submission test (quality-checks.md ###7): a static page fails gate render (needs real sign-in with a wrong-password negative control, 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'); a mock/browser-only store fails gate constraints (UI-created job and candidate must be seen by the Observer in a new independent browser context; 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'). Gates are all_pass and score.py:41-48 zeroes reward when a gate fails or functional <= floor 0.05. Functional is 43 binary criteria totalling weight 58.5, dominated by concurrency, bulk, undo, live, conversation and privacy rows; polish (5 rows) is entirely live-update/draft/scroll-anchoring/offline-send/session-resume behaviour, which a CRUD stub scores 0 on. Weak-app probe (analytical, not run): a single-CRUD 'jobs + candidates' app with login and SQLite persistence passes both gates and could earn hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_restart 1.5 = 3.5/58.5 = 0.060 functional, just above the template-controlled floor 0.05 (template tests/scoring.toml is identical), giving roughly 0.036 + 0.2*visual (likert, likely low without board/conversation/activity surfaces) ~ 0.04-0.15 total, versus a full build near 1. So the stub is clearly separated and cannot 'satisfy the ask'; residual small partial credit is a template floor property, not a row-7 defect. Conforming-alternative probe: the brief leaves routes, layout, drag optionality, live transport (polling/SSE/sockets) and draft storage to the builder (rules preamble, s5, s6 Drafts), so a conforming real build is not forced into the golden's shape; nothing in the ask makes real work unrewardable. Risk flag: the raw-evidence-index scope states 'reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so the claim that stubs earn ~0 (and the analytical ~0.06 functional CRUD residual) is unmeasured; this is missing runtime evidence, not a demonstrated defect.
